mapper.sql: w.wo_id, w.wo_no, w.plant_cd, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, trim_scale(w.plan_qty)::text as plan_qty, w.unit_cd, w.status, w.plan_start, (select trim_scale(q.good + q.disp_good)::text from prd_wo_proc p cross join lateral hb_proc_qty(p.wo_proc_id) q where p.wo_id = w.wo_id order by p.op_seq desc limit 1) as last_good_qty, (select trim_scale(coalesce(sum(r.qty), 0))::text from prd_receipt r where r.wo_id = w.wo_id) as received_qty
from prd_wo w join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id
mapper.select:
select from ( select w.wo_id from prd_wo w join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id
order by
w.wo_no i.item_cd w.status w.plan_start
desc,
w.wo_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset} ) k join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = k.wo_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id order by
w.wo_no i.item_cd w.status w.plan_start
desc,
w.wo_id desc
select count(*) from prd_wo w join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id

with last as ( select p.wo_proc_id from prd_wo_proc p where p.wo_id = #{woId} order by p.op_seq desc limit 1 ), outs as ( select r.lot_id from prd_result r join last on last.wo_proc_id = r.wo_proc_id where r.lot_id is not null union select w.lot_id from prd_rework w join last on last.wo_proc_id = w.wo_proc_id where w.lot_id is not null ) select l.lot_id, l.lot_no, trim_scale(l.qty_created)::text as qty_created, trim_scale(coalesce(rc.received, 0))::text as received_qty, trim_scale(l.qty_created - coalesce(rc.received, 0))::text as remain_qty, l.hold_yn, l.occurred_at from outs join lot_master l on l.lot_id = outs.lot_id left join (select lot_id, sum(qty) as received from prd_receipt where wo_id = #{woId} group by lot_id) rc on rc.lot_id = l.lot_id order by l.occurred_at, l.lot_id

select r.receipt_id, r.lot_id, l.lot_no, r.node_id, h.node_cd, trim_scale(r.qty)::text as qty, r.unit_cd, r.entry_method, r.reversal_of_id, exists (select 1 from prd_receipt x where x.reversal_of_id = r.receipt_id) as reversed, r.reason, r.occurred_at, r.recorded_by from prd_receipt r join lot_master l on l.lot_id = r.lot_id join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = r.node_id where r.wo_id = #{woId} order by r.occurred_at desc, r.receipt_id desc

select h.node_id, h.node_cd, h.node_nm, h.node_type, p.node_cd as parent_cd from mst_equip_hier h left join mst_equip_hier p on p.node_id = h.parent_id where h.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and h.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') and h.use_yn = 'Y' order by coalesce(p.node_cd, h.node_cd), h.node_type desc, h.node_cd
mapper.sql: r.receipt_id, r.wo_id, r.lot_id, r.node_id, r.qty, r.reversal_of_id, exists (select 1 from prd_receipt x where x.reversal_of_id = r.receipt_id) as reversed from prd_receipt r
mapper.select: insert into prd_receipt (comp_cd, plant_cd, wo_id, item_id, lot_id, node_id, qty, unit_cd, client_req_id, reason, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by, reversal_of_id) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.plantCd}, #{f.woId}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.lotId}, #{f.nodeId}, #{f.qty}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.clientReqId}, #{f.reason}, #{at}, #{f.entryMethod}, #{by}, #{f.reversalOfId}) returning receipt_id
